See our privacy policy . Earthmoving Adelaide questions before work begins What is the difference between earthmoving and excavation? Earthmoving is the broader shaping and preparation of ground. Excavation is the removal of material to a defined profile, area or depth. A project may include both, but the brief should name the required finish. Do you handle small residential jobs? Small jobs can be reviewed when the location, access, dimensions, material and required outcome are supplied. Suitability and minimum charges depend on the independent provider's written scope. Can you work in tight-access yards? Access must be measured along the whole route, including gates, turns, overhead limits, surfaces and loading space. A machine passing one opening does not prove it can work or transfer spoil safely. Do I need development approval? Approval depends on the proposal, property and planning controls. Check current PlanSA information and seek qualified advice where levels, drainage, retaining, heritage or other regulated matters may be affected. Who checks underground services? The person controlling the work must arrange suitable asset information and site-specific controls. Public plans may not show private services or exact depth, so physical confirmation may also be required.
